translations.Az ősz illata egyetlen kis gyertyába zár: The scent of autumn captured in a single little candle.
translations.A Sütőtök erdő meleg, fűszeres és kellem:
The warm, spicy and pleasantly sweet fragrance of Pumpkin Forest evokes those moments when the weather outside turns chilly and it feels lovely to curl up indoors under a soft blanket. The distinctive pairing of pumpkin and cinnamon creates a truly autumnal atmosphere, while the tiny hedgehog and leaves nestled on top add a little woodland charm. This is a candle that naturally calls for a hot drink, a soft jumper and a peaceful evening. 🤎

## Fragrance notes
🎃 pumpkin · 🤎 cinnamon · 🍂 warm, spicy, sweet autumnal notes
translations.Egy kis gyümölcsös desszertélmény – kaná: A little fruity dessert experience — no spoon required.
translations.Az Áfonyás joghurttorta friss, üde és ke:
The fresh, lively and pleasantly fruity fragrance of Blueberry Yogurt Cake feels like tasting a light dessert with a delicious blueberry twist. Four small, piped cream-style decorations crown the soft purple base, while the blueberries on top make it look even more realistic. A playful, distinctive candle that brings together the comforting feel of creamy desserts and the freshness of blueberries. 💜

This candle is handmade, so the shade of the purple base, the shape and size of the piped decorations, and the placement of the blueberries may vary slightly from piece to piece. These differences give each candle its own unique dessert character.
translations.Az Ölelő nyuszi a kedvesség és a gondosk: The Hugging Bunny is a charming little symbol of kindness and care.
translations.Rózsaszín, puha hatású megjelenését a ké:
Its pink, soft-looking appearance is made especially endearing by tiny hand-painted details, while the delicate cherry blossom fragrance adds a fresh, floral atmosphere. The little bunny’s hugging shape makes it a particularly sweet gift for Easter, a baby shower, a birthday or simply whenever you want to bring someone a little joy. 🌸💗 Although it evokes spring and Easter, the Hugging Bunny is available all year round.

Every bunny is handmade and hand-painted. Facial details, eyes, lines and small painted features may therefore vary slightly from piece to piece. These little differences make each bunny unique.
translations.Egy kis figyelmesség annak, aki mindig t: A little token of appreciation for the person who always knows how to put the world right.
translations.A „Te vagy a legjobb Apa!” gyertya egysz:
The “You’re the Best Dad!” candle is a thoughtful, personal gift with a distinctly dad-like character. Its pleasantly spicy, slightly sweet Smoked Cigar & Old Whiskey fragrance is distinctive without being overpowering or intrusive, creating just the warm, homely and masculine atmosphere that suits it so well.

Small brown tool decorations make the white base special: it may feature a hammer, a screwdriver and other DIY-inspired details. A loving surprise for Father’s Day, a birthday, Christmas or simply to show him that he really is the best dad. 🤎

Every candle is handmade, so the type, size and placement of the tool decorations, as well as the colour of the wax, may vary slightly. There may be small differences between the hand-poured details, but each piece is made with the same care.
translations.Egy apró adag szeretet, cseresznyevirág-: A little dose of love, wrapped in the scent of cherry blossom.
translations.A Púderfülű nyuszi bájos, kedves megjele:
The Powder-Eared Bunny’s charming appearance and delicate details will bring a smile to your face straight away. Hand-painted details make the simple beauty of white soy wax truly unique, while the soft, floral cherry blossom fragrance creates a pleasantly fresh and romantic atmosphere.

Every bunny is handmade and hand-painted, so facial details, eyes, lines and small painted features may vary slightly from piece to piece. These little differences are precisely what make them special — no two Powder-Eared Bunnies are exactly alike.
translations.A frissen mosott ruhák tisztasága, a puh: The freshness of newly washed clothes, the pleasant scent of soft fabrics and the comforting warmth of home, all in one little package.
translations.Az otthon illata finom, öblítős, tiszta:
The Scent of Home has a delicate, clean and fresh fabric-softener fragrance that feels as though you have just hung out freshly washed laundry.

A perfect choice if you love the atmosphere of a tidy, clean home and would like to fill your surroundings with a fresh, pleasant fragrance. The glitter in the wax shimmers beautifully as it melts, adding a special visual touch to the fragrance experience. ✨

## Fragrance notes
Clean freshness · fabric softener · freshly washed laundry · a soft, fresh and pleasantly clean fragrance
translations.A Málnás panna cotta kívül-belül a málná: Raspberry Panna Cotta evokes raspberry cheesecake inside and out: it looks like a creamy, fruity treat, with a fragrance so intense that it wins everyone over from the very first moment.
translations.Nem véletlenül lett az egyik nagy kedven:
It is no surprise that this has become a firm favourite — this candle truly brings a little dessert experience into your home, except you light it rather than eat it. 🤍

As each candle is handmade, the top layer and the colour, size and placement of the raspberry decorations may vary slightly. This makes every panna cotta unique, while the overall appearance still evokes the same raspberry dessert experience.
translations.Frissítő, energizáló és üde illat, amely: A refreshing, energising and uplifting fragrance that brightens your mood in an instant.
translations.A Szicíliai citrom & mentol illatviaszba:
Sicilian Lemon & Menthol Wax Melts combine citrus freshness with the cool, clean character of menthol for a truly invigorating fragrance experience.

The two-toned, flower-shaped melts are a distinctive sight: one half is green and the other yellow, while the glitter inside shimmers beautifully as they melt. 🍋🌿

## Fragrance notes
Sicilian lemon · menthol · refreshing, citrusy and energising notes
translations.Egy kis virágos hangulat, amely sokáig m: A little floral charm that keeps its beauty for a long time.
translations.A tulipáncsokor gyertya a friss virágok:
The Tulip Bouquet candle captures the charm of fresh flowers while bringing a distinctive, lasting decoration into your home. Its tulip fragrance feels like stepping into a florist’s shop: clean, fresh and pleasantly floral, gently filling the space around it. Each piece is handmade, so no two bouquets are exactly alike — small variations in colour make each one truly unique. As a result of the handmade process, shades, the wax surface and small details may vary slightly from piece to piece. The shape and overall appearance always follow the tulip bouquet shown.

The Tulip Bouquet is available in several colours, so you can easily choose the shade that best suits you or the person receiving it as a gift. 🌷
translations.A levendula nyugodt, tiszta és jellegzet: The calm, clean and distinctive scent of lavender, complemented by a hint of rosy freshness.
translations.A Levendula & rózsa illatviaszban elsőso:
Lavender takes the lead in Lavender & Rose Wax Melts, while rose appears gently in the background to soften and freshen the overall fragrance.

The glitter inside these purple wax shapes shimmers beautifully as they melt, adding a special visual touch to the fragrance experience. 💜
translations.A frissen szedett eper édes, üde és gyüm: The sweet, lively and fruity fragrance of freshly picked strawberries, wrapped in a little pink charm.
translations.Az Epres érintés illatviasz könnyed, kel:
Strawberry Touch Wax Melts create a light, pleasantly sweet atmosphere, as though you were picking fresh strawberries on a sunny summer day.

The subtle glitter inside these bow-shaped melts shimmers beautifully as they melt, making the fragrance experience a treat for the eyes as well. 🦋🍓

## Fragrance notes
Freshly picked strawberries · sweet, fruity notes · lively summer freshness
translations.**Egy meleg, karakteres illat, amely egy:

The intense, fruity fragrance of Tuscan Sunset brings together ripe grapes and the distinctive aroma of Otello grapes. It feels like arriving in a quiet vineyard at the end of a long summer day, with the sweet, deep scent of grapes still lingering in the air. A truly distinctive candle for those who love a fragrance with presence.

These wax melts are a distinctive favourite: rich, spicy and irresistibly autumnal, filling the room in moments with the atmosphere and aroma of pumpkin-spiced treats. 🎃☕🍂

translations.Egy ölelésnyi kedvesség, virágokba öntve: A hug’s worth of kindness, cast in flowers.
translations.A kis virágos macik játékos, mégis bájos:
These little floral teddy bears are playful yet charmingly elegant pieces that bring a little love and cheer to everyday life. The Strawberry Touch fragrance is lovely, fruity and pleasantly sweet, as delicate as the light aroma of a fresh strawberry treat drifting through the room. Rose details and a heart in the centre make this little candle even more special, whether it is a gift or a small treat for yourself. 🍓🤍

As each candle is handmade, colour shades, the wax surface and small details may vary slightly from piece to piece. This makes every teddy bear unique, while its shape and overall appearance follow the version you have chosen.
translations.Egy különleges illat, amelyben az édes k: A distinctive fragrance that brings together sweet caramel and juicy cherries.
translations.Az Elvarázsolt üst karakteres, intenzív:
The distinctive, intense fragrance of Enchanted Cauldron evokes both the warmth of freshly baked treats and the atmosphere of cooler autumn and winter evenings. The gentle sweetness of caramel is complemented by the fruity character of cherries, creating a rich, slightly bakery-like fragrance with a playful twist. The cauldron-shaped container and hand-painted wax decoration add a touch of mystery, while the shimmer makes it even more magical.

## Fragrance notes
🍮 caramel · 🍒 cherry · ✨ sweet, intense, subtly bakery-like autumn and winter notes
The atmosphere of preparing for the festive season.
translations.A Sült alma & vörösáfonya kellemesen éde:

Warm and homely without being too heavy, it naturally brings to mind candlelight, the aroma of baking and the excitement of the season. White and red colours, tiny apple and cranberry decorations and a delicate shimmer give this special little candle a festive appearance. ❤️✨

translations.Helyezz a párologtató vagy viaszmelegítő:
Place a suitable number of pieces in the upper dish of your wax burner or warmer, depending on the size of the dish. One piece is enough for an average-sized burner! Then heat the wax according to your warmer’s instructions.

One portion of wax melts can be used several times: depending on the fragrance intensity and heating time, you can usually enjoy the clean fragrance reminiscent of freshly washed laundry for another 2–3 sessions. When the fragrance is no longer noticeable, allow the wax to cool completely, then remove the hardened wax.

Do NOT mix the wax with water or essential oils, and never leave the warmer unattended.

Important information

As these items are handmade, their shape, size, colour and distribution of glitter may vary slightly. Each wax melt is individually made with love in the H’infini Candles studio.
